featured.name: Official ATS Convoy - Boat show
featured.description:
### You're **all invited** to haul a boat to Yakima! 👀  

> The yearly Yakima Sprint Boat racing now has a new edition with a regular boat show that is being held at the end of November. For this we require several boats to being hauled to various companies in Yakima from their storage location in Wenatchee.

The event takes place on the **14th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  

---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your timezone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P4sECCF_QEadR)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38596.1792995339.jpg)

---

### :truck: | **Cargo**  

We kindly request you to haul a boat  

You can use our TruckersMP Truck Delivery Dispatcher to select your cargo to Yakima.

![Truck Delivery Dispatcher](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/516fd848-53ae-41ba-9b78-7974591827c0.avif)  

If you want to know more about our Truck Delivery Dispatcher you can read this [article](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/1410)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Wenatchee** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you into Coastline Mining.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121346-official-ats-convoy-boat-show/)**!

featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.

today.description:
# 🎃 **HAUNTED CANYON ROADS | GTLEGION** 👻

October brings a different atmosphere to the American highways — longer shadows, colder evenings and endless roads cutting through some of the most spectacular landscapes in the United States.

Join GTLEGION for an unforgettable journey through legendary canyon roads, dramatic rock formations and wide-open American landscapes. This public ATS convoy is all about the road itself: breathtaking scenery, iconic highways and the unique atmosphere of the American West during the Halloween season.

upcoming.description:
## OFFICIAL LTR PINKTOBER CONVOY! 🌸
- Oficiální konvoj pro podporu léčby a prevence rakoviny prsu - Pinktober.
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/IaCWTde.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. The CARGO is reccomended for flowers & medical equipment or vaccines.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)
9. The convoy is mainly organized in Czech language, however we will use English.

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **18:30** - Meet at the parking slots in TruckersMP HQ.
*  **19:00**  - Departure from TruckersMP large parking.
*  **19:20**  - Passage trough the city of Prague.
*  **20:00**  - Passage around the city of Sttutgart.
*  **20:40** - Arrival of the convoy to the Geneva.
*  **20:45** - Final group photo and end of the convoy.



![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/DOffoNx.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

**1. TruckersMP HQ, Cargotras - Geneva, SellPlan.**


-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.

*Remember to monitor slot occupancy on the server and communicate with us.*

upcoming.description:
# 🎉🚛 BESA LOGISTIC – GEBURTSTAGS-KONVOI 2026 🚛🎉

### MORE THAN A DESTINATION – GEMEINSAM AUF ALLEN STRASSEN!

Die BESA LOGISTIC lädt alle Speditionen sowie freie Fahrerinnen und Fahrer herzlich zu unserem großen Geburtstags-Konvoi ein!

Gemeinsam möchten wir diesen besonderen Anlass feiern und einen unvergesslichen Abend auf den Straßen von Euro Truck Simulator 2 verbringen.

Freut euch auf eine wunderschöne Strecke, eine organisierte Kolonne und eine starke Gemeinschaft!

### 📅 VERANSTALTUNGSINFORMATIONEN

📆 Datum: Freitag, 30. Oktober 2026

🕢 Treffen: 19:30 Uhr (Londoner Zeit)

🚦 Abfahrt: 20:00 Uhr (Londoner Zeit)

📍 Start: München – BCP

🏁 Ziel: Osnabrück – LKW-Händler

🎮 Server: Simulation 2

🚛 Veranstaltung: Geburtstags-Konvoi



# 🚨 WICHTIGE KONVOI-REGELN 🚨

⛔ FRACHT- UND TRANSPORTVORSCHRIFTEN

❌ KEINE SCHWERLASTTRANSPORTE!

⚖️ MAXIMALES FRACHTGEWICHT: 10 TONNEN!

❌ Keine überbreiten oder überlangen Sondertransporte.

✅ Es sind ausschließlich normale, für den Konvoi geeignete Auflieger erlaubt.

# 🚛 GESCHWINDIGKEITSBEGRENZUNGEN

🏘️ INNERORTS: 50 KM/H

🌳 LANDSTRASSE: MAXIMAL 60 KM/H

🛣️ AUTOBAHN: MAXIMAL 70 KM/H

Diese Geschwindigkeiten sind für alle Teilnehmer verbindlich!
# 
# 📋 ALLGEMEINE VERHALTENSREGELN

Den Anweisungen der Konvoi-Leitung und Absicherung ist Folge zu leisten.

Überholen ist während des gesamten Konvois verboten, sofern es nicht ausdrücklich erlaubt wird.

Ausreichend Sicherheitsabstand zum vorausfahrenden LKW einhalten.

Absichtliches Rammen, Blockieren oder gefährliches Fahren ist strengstens untersagt.

Respektvoller Umgang mit allen Fahrerinnen und Fahrern ist Pflicht.

Beleidigungen, Belästigungen und Provokationen werden nicht toleriert.

Während des Konvois sind unnötige Stopps und eigenmächtige Routenänderungen zu vermeiden.

Bei technischen Problemen ist die Konvoi-Leitung zu informieren.

Die vorgegebene Route ist einzuhalten.

Wer wiederholt gegen die Regeln verstößt, kann vom Konvoi ausgeschlossen werden

upcoming.description:
# 🚛 Guiding Line Auto | October Convoy 2026
## 🌍 Welcome to the Guiding Line Auto October Convoy!

Dear partners, friends, and members of the TruckersMP community!

We are delighted to invite you to our **October Convoy**, hosted under our new identity — **Guiding Line Auto (GLA)**!

Following our recent rebranding from Path of Freedom, we are opening a new chapter in our company's journey. While our name and visual identity have changed, our passion for trucking, friendship, and bringing the community together remains stronger than ever.

### 📅 Event Information

### **⛟ Date:** 31/10/2026
### **⛟ Departure:** Duisburg (Slots)
### **⛟ Destination:** Prague (Steinbruch)
### **⛟ Distance:** 1130 km
### **⛟ Meeting time:** 18:00 UTC
### **⛟ Departure time:** 19:00 UTC
### **⛟ DLC:** None
### **⛟ Convoy Control:** Yes
### **⛟ Server:** ---

### 🎟️ Slot Booking

We warmly welcome all VTCs and individual drivers to participate in our convoy!

**You can book a slot through our official Discord server:**

### **[🚛 Join GLA Discord & Book Your Slot](https://discord.com/invite/SV8EvH4HTs)**

We look forward to seeing you on the road!

---
## 🇺🇦 Ласкаво просимо на жовтневий конвой Guiding Line Auto!

Шановні партнери, друзі та учасники спільноти TruckersMP!

Компанія **Guiding Line Auto (GLA)** з радістю запрошує вас на наш **жовтневий конвой**, який ми проводимо вже під новою назвою та в оновленому фірмовому стилі!

Після ребрендингу Path of Freedom ми розпочинаємо нову сторінку нашої історії. Незважаючи на зміни назви та зовнішнього вигляду компанії, наші цінності залишаються незмінними: дружба, взаємоповага, командний дух та любов до віртуальних перевезень.

### 📅 Інформація про конвой
### **⛟ Дата:** 31/10/2026
### **⛟ Відправлення:** Дуйсбург (Слоти)
### **⛟ Місце призначення:** Прага (Steinbruch)

### 🎟️ Бронювання слотів
Ми щиро запрошуємо всі віртуальні транспортні компанії та незалежних водіїв долучитися до нашого заходу!

**Забронювати слот для своєї компанії можна на нашому офіційному Discord-сервері:**

### **[🚛 Приєднатися до Discord GLA та забронювати слот](https://discord.com/invite/SV8EvH4HTs)**

**Guiding Line Auto — Together We Drive Further!**

- Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
- Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff
- All other TruckersMP rules apply.

### This Event marks the final chapter of Novi Trucking, now continuing its journey alongside NorthStar Group, as we celebrate the miles we’ve shared together
###

-----

**Welcome to NorthStar Group | Novi Farewell Convoy**

Hosted by NorthStar Group, we invite the TruckersMP community to join us for one final drive as we close the chapter of Novi Trucking and begin a new journey together. This Convoy is more than just an event; it is a tribute to everything Novi Trucking has been - the friendships formed, the memories created, and the roads we’ve travelled as a community
